worker_processes.description: Number of worker processes (e.g., 'auto' to match CPU cores).

pid_file.description: Path to the Nginx PID file.

error_log.path.description: Path to the error log file.

error_log.level.description: Minimum log level. Lower levels include more detail.

events.description: Low-level I/O handling and connection settings.

events.worker_connections.description: Max number of simultaneous connections per worker process.

events.multi_accept.description: If enabled, workers accept all new connections at once instead of one at a time.

include_paths.description: Standard filesystem paths for included configuration fragments.

include_paths.mime_types.description: Path to MIME types definition file.

include_paths.conf.d.description: Directory to include additional server-wide configuration fragments.

include_paths.sites.description: Directory to include virtual host/server block files.

default_type.description: Default MIME type for responses when type cannot be determined.

access_log.path.description: Path to global access log file.

log_formats.description: List of custom log format definitions (e.g., for structured logging).

log_formats[].name.description: Name of the log format (used in access_log directives).

log_formats[].format.description: Custom log format string using Nginx variables. Escape newlines and quotes.

sendfile.description: Use kernel sendfile() for static file transfers (improves performance).

tcp_nopush.description: Enable TCP_NOPUSH (Linux) to coalesce packets before sending.

tcp_nodelay.description: Disable Nagle's algorithm for low-latency streaming (e.g., WebSocket).

keepalive_timeout.description: Duration (in seconds) to keep idle client connections open.

client_max_body_size.description: Maximum allowed size of client request body (e.g., '1m', '10m').

gzip.types.description: MIME types to compress (wildcards like 'text/*' accepted).

gzip.min_length.description: Minimum response size (in bytes) to compress.

server_tokens.description: If true, hide Nginx version in response headers (security hardening).

upstreams.description: Upstream (backend) server groups for load balancing.

upstreams[].name.description: Name of the upstream group (used in proxy_pass).

upstreams[].balance_method.description: Load balancing method. For 'hash', include a key (e.g., '$request_uri').

upstreams[].servers.description: List of backend servers in this upstream group.

upstreams[].keepalive.description: Number of idle keepalive connections to upstream (for HTTP/1.1).

servers.description: Virtual hosts (server blocks) defining how Nginx handles different domains/paths.

servers[].root.description: Document root directory for static content.

servers[].ssl.enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS for this server block.

servers[].ssl.cert_path.description: Path to SSL certificate file (PEM format).

servers[].ssl.key_path.description: Path to SSL private key file (PEM format).

servers[].location_blocks.description: List of location block configurations (URL paths and their behavior).

servers[].location_blocks[].root.description: Override root for this location (e.g., for subdirectories).

servers[].location_blocks[].auth_basic_u.description: Path to htpasswd file for basic auth.

servers[].location_blocks[].add_header.description: Custom headers to add to responses.

servers[].location_blocks[].return.description: Return a static response (redirect or error).

servers[].location_blocks[].add_trailer.description: HTTP trailer headers to add (for chunked responses).
